cases.topic: fiscal stabilization, education and long-term societal capacity
accountability_questions: Who designed or proposed the policy?
What professional and educational backgrounds do accountable leaders publicly document?
What expertise is present at institutional rather than individual level?
Which internal technical bodies, advisers, evaluators and budget offices participated?
What evidence and models were used?
What dissent, warnings or alternative options were documented?
What outcomes are measured after implementation?
Which future options or capabilities may be lost or strengthened?
boundaries: public professional background is relevant only when connected to role, decision process or institutional competence
individual credentials do not prove policy quality
absence of a degree does not prove lack of competence
leadership credentials must not be used as a proxy for the education level of a whole ministry
distinguish formal authority, analytic expertise, decision ownership and implementation responsibility
